findings.issue_summary: Data Safety Compliant (Local-Only) - no video data exists; the MediaRecorder matches are audio-source constants, not video capture
findings.evidence: Forward trace shows no video is ever captured. Every `MediaRecorder` reference is the audio-source constant enum, never a `MediaRecorder` instance and never a camera/video surface: Mikrofonbefund.kt:27-29 (`MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC`, `.VOICE_RECOGNITION`, `.UNPROCESSED`), Nebenlaufversuch.kt:208 (`AudioRecord(MediaRecorder.AudioSource.VOICE_RECOGNITION, rate, ...)`) and Sprachlauf.kt:238 (`AudioRecord(MediaRecorder.AudioSource.VOICE_RECOGNITION, ABTASTRATE, ...)`). All three construct `android.media.AudioRecord`, i.e. raw PCM microphone reads, not video. There is no CAMERA permission in app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml (only RECORD_AUDIO) and none in app/src/forschung/AndroidManifest.xml. Semantic grounding therefore fails for the VIDEOS data type - a false positive of the `MediaRecorder` pattern. Additionally there is no off-device sink of any kind: a repo-wide grep over app/src and simple-keyboard/src for HttpURLConnection, okhttp, Retrofit, java.net.URL and Ktor returns only the unit test app/src/test/java/de/ithandwerkstuttgart/nibra/BauartTest.kt, and gradle/libs.versions.toml declares no Firebase, Crashlytics, analytics, ads, okhttp or retrofit dependency. The shipped `offline` flavor holds no INTERNET permission (app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml declares only android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO), and the Gradle task `pruefeNetzfreiheit` in app/build.gradle.kts fails the build if INTERNET or ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE ever appears in a merged offline manifest.
findings.recommendation: Declare no VIDEOS data type in the Play Console Data Safety form - the app neither records nor accesses video. Keep the `pruefeNetzfreiheit` Gradle gate and the CAMERA-free manifest so this stays provable; if a video feature is ever added, re-run this trace before the next release.

findings.issue_summary: Data Safety Compliant (Local-Only): microphone audio is consumed by the on-device speech recognizer and in-memory PCM analysis only; no off-device sink exists
findings.evidence: Forward trace from each listed SpeechRecognizer source ends on-device. Absichtsversuch.kt:130-134 selects `SpeechRecognizer.createOnDeviceSpeechRecognizer(zusammenhang)` when `SpeechRecognizer.isOnDeviceRecognitionAvailable(zusammenhang)` is true and otherwise `SpeechRecognizer.createSpeechRecognizer(zusammenhang)`, with the recognition Intent built at line 68 carrying `putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_PREFER_OFFLINE, true)`. Biasingversuch.kt:166-169 and :243 and Dauerversuch.kt:225-228 and :340 use the identical pattern. Results are read back locally as `SpeechRecognizer.RESULTS_RECOGNITION` (Absichtsversuch.kt:225, Biasingversuch.kt:256, Dauerversuch.kt:350) and never passed to a network call. The raw-PCM paths are likewise terminal: Mikrofonbefund.kt:128-140 reads into a local `ShortArray` buffer and keeps only a peak-amplitude integer, releasing the AudioRecord at :151-153 - no file write and no upload. No off-device sink is reachable from any of these files or the wider app: grep for HttpURLConnection/okhttp/Retrofit/java.net.URL/Ktor over app/src and simple-keyboard/src matches only the unit test BauartTest.kt, and gradle/libs.versions.toml contains no Firebase, Crashlytics, analytics or ads SDK, so heuristics 1 (logger loop) and 2 (SDK siphoning) find nothing. The shipped `offline` flavor cannot transmit at all: app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml requests only android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO with an explicit comment that recognition runs on-device, and app/build.gradle.kts registers `pruefeNetzfreiheit`, which throws a GradleException if INTERNET or ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE appears in any merged offline manifest. INTERNET exists only in app/src/forschung/AndroidManifest.xml, a measurement-only flavor with `applicationIdSuffix = ".forschung"` and `versionNameSuffix = "-forschung"` (app/build.gradle.kts productFlavors) that is never shipped. Because `is_transferred` is false, Step 2 (prominent-disclosure search) is not applicable.
findings.recommendation: In the Play Console Data Safety form, declare that Audio / voice recordings are collected but NOT transferred off-device (processed on-device only), or select the on-device-processing option, matching the RECORD_AUDIO-only manifest. Keep the `pruefeNetzfreiheit` build gate wired into CI and keep all cloud-recognizer experiments confined to src/forschung, so the offline release stays provably network-free. If the `forschung` flavor is ever built with a cloud recognizer, do not publish that artifact.
